import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int MAXID = 505;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int SRC = 501;
    static final int SNK = 502;

    static char[][] gridA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distPair = new int[MAXID][MAXID];

    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, flow, next;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int flow, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] headNode = new int[MAXID];
    static int[] depth = new int[MAXID];
    static int[] seen = new int[MAXID];
    static int[] parentEdge = new int[MAXID];
    static int answer = 0;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        int idx = edges.size();
        edges.add(new Edge(v, cap, 0, headNode[u]));
        headNode[u] = idx;
        edges.add(new Edge(u, 0, 0, headNode[v]));
        headNode[v] = idx + 1;
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Queue<Integer> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
        Arrays.fill(depth, 0);
        qu.add(SRC);
        seen[SRC] = 1;
        depth[SRC] = 1;
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qu.poll();
            for (int i = headNode[x]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                int y = edges.get(i).to;
                if (seen[y] == 0 && edges.get(i).flow < edges.get(i).cap) {
                    parentEdge[y] = i;
                    seen[y] = 1;
                    depth[y] = depth[x] + 1;
                    qu.add(y);
                    if (y == SNK) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int x, int now) {
        if (x == SNK || now == 0) return now;
        int rem = now;
        for (int i = headNode[x]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
            int y = edges.get(i).to;
            if (edges.get(i).cap > edges.get(i).flow && depth[y] == depth[x] + 1) {
                int pushed = sendFlow(y, Math.min(rem, edges.get(i).cap - edges.get(i).flow));
                if (pushed == 0) depth[y] = 0;
                edges.get(i).flow += pushed;
                edges.get(i ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                rem -= pushed;
                if (rem == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return now - rem;
    }

    static void dinic() {
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            answer += sendFlow(SRC, INF);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        Arrays.fill(headNode, -1);
        edges.clear();

        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                distZ[i][j] = 10000;
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                int startId = (i - 1) * n + j;
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(startId);
                    distZ[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(SRC, startId, gridA[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = (cur - 1) / n + 1;
            int y = (cur - 1) % n + 1;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && gridA[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                    distZ[nx][ny] > distZ[x][y] + 1) {
                    distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add((nx - 1) * n + ny);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > '9') continue;
                int startId = (i - 1) * n + j;
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        distPair[startId][(k - 1) * n + l] = 10000;
                    }
                }
                q.add(startId);
                distPair[startId][startId] = 0;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int cur = q.poll();
                    int x = (cur - 1) / n + 1;
                    int y = (cur - 1) % n + 1;
                    for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[f];
                        int ny = y + dy[f];
                        if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && gridA[nx][ny] <= '9') {
                            int nextId = (nx - 1) * n + ny;
                            if (distPair[startId][nextId] > distPair[startId][cur] + 1 &&
                                distPair[startId][cur] < distZ[x][y]) {
                                distPair[startId][nextId] = distPair[startId][cur] + 1;
                                q.add(nextId);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        int destId = (k - 1) * n + l;
                        if (distPair[startId][destId] <= Math.min(distZ[k][l], timeLimit)) {
                            addEdge(startId, destId + 100, 10000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (gridB[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge((i - 1) * n + j + 100, SNK, gridB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        dinic();
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
